channel.title: Flowdeck Blog
channel.description: Guides and news on building iOS and macOS apps with AI agents and FlowDeck.

item.title: Git Worktrees Explained: What iOS Developers Need to Know
item.description: Git worktrees let you check out branches from one repository in separate folders, and Flowdeck Studio uses them to run parallel Claude Code sessions on Xcode projects.

item.title: How to Make Claude Code Validate its work
item.description: Flowdeck Studio helps developers validate Claude Code changes in iOS apps before code review with built-in testing, simulator checks, screenshots, and validation reports.

item.title: How to Run Multiple Claude Code Agents on the Same Xcode Project
item.description: Flowdeck Studio lets you run multiple Claude Code agents on the same Xcode project in parallel, with separate Git worktrees, build data, and a dedicated simulator for each session.

item.title: How to stream iOS simulator logs to your AI coding agent
item.description: Flowdeck CLI streams live iOS simulator logs to Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor so your agent can debug with the app’s actual output.

item.title: iOS UI automation: tap, type, screenshot
iOS simulator management for AI agents
item.description: Flowdeck CLI lets developers, CI scripts, and AI coding agents boot and manage iOS simulators by name without hardcoding machine-specific UDIDs.

item.title: Two agents, same task, same standards
item.description: See how two coding agents handled the same iOS task when Flowdeck Studio gave both the same coding standards and captured evidence from their builds, tests, and simulator checks.

item.title: Why AI agents fail at iOS development
item.description: Flowdeck helps Claude Code and Codex catch iOS bugs by giving them feedback from builds, tests, simulators, and app logs.

item.title: MCP vs CLI for AI-powered iOS development
item.description: Compare how XcodeBuildMCP and Flowdeck CLI give iOS coding agents access to builds, tests, and simulators, and how each handles tool discovery, agent context, CI, and structured output.

item.title: A modern simctl alternative for iOS simulators
item.description: Flowdeck CLI is an alternative to xcrun simctl that lets you boot and erase iOS simulators, install and launch apps, and take screenshots by simulator name, with JSON output for every command.

item.title: How to run iOS tests from the terminal
item.description: Use Flowdeck CLI to discover, filter by target, and run iOS unit and UI tests from the terminal, with structured output for CI.

item.title: Set up Claude Code and Codex for iOS development
item.description: Set up Claude Code or Codex for iOS development with Flowdeck CLI so your agent can build, run, and test your app, read its logs, and verify a screen in the simulator.

item.title: Autonomous iOS UI testing with Claude Code
item.description: Use Flowdeck CLI to let Claude Code inspect accessibility, interact with an iOS app in the simulator, verify the result, capture evidence, and fix failures.

item.title: Three ways to close the iOS agent loop
item.description: Compare three ways to close the iOS build-run-test loop for Claude Code or Codex, including how Flowdeck CLI gives agents one interface to build, run, and test their changes.
